description_en: Deletes an application allocation record and revokes the permissions of a specified principal to use a specified application
description_zh: 删除应用分配记录，撤销指定主体的指定应用使用权限
name: DeleteApplicationAssignment

parameters.help_en:
The principal name of the RAM user or the role name.

User principal name: The format is `<username>@<account-id>.onaliyun.com`. You can query the name by calling the GetUser or ListUsers API.
Role name: You can query the name by calling the RAM ListRoles API
parameters.help_zh:
RAM 用户主体名称或角色名称。

用户主体名称：格式为`<username>@<account-id>.onaliyun.com`，可通过调用`GetUser`或`ListUsers` API 查询。
角色名称：可通过调用 RAM `ListRoles` API 查询
parameters.name: principal_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the target principal for the application allocation. Valid values:

user: The principal type is RAM user. In this case, PrincipalName must be a user principal name.
role: The principal type is RAM role. In this case, PrincipalName must be a role name
parameters.help_zh:
应用分配的目标主体类型。

user：主体类型为 RAM 用户，此时 PrincipalName 必须是用户主体名称。
role：主体类型为 RAM 角色，此时 PrincipalName 必须是角色名称
parameters.name: principal_type
